## limitations

The session serves operations only after Ghidra reports default auto-analysis complete; incomplete analysis does not expose partial results.,The imported Program and temporary project are ephemeral and deleted on close. Annotation operations edit session database metadata; original executable bytes are never written.,Cancelling an active Ghidra request terminates its ephemeral database and discards session annotations. The selected target remains open; the next provider query imports the original artifact again.,Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.,References cover the complete Ghidra function-body AddressSet and exact entry.
